> 第1章 被欺辱（第1页）
天武大陆，有四大武域：天武域、乾坤武域、仓山武域、武神域。每个武域由皇室和宗门组成，宗派林立。其中，最强的四大武域是武神域，而最弱的武域则是天武域。元神宗就位于这个最弱的武域之中。
“李天，你这个废物，给我滚出来！”屋外的呵斥叫喊声让床上的李天立刻爬了起来。他一身是伤，走路都一瘸一拐。当李天打开房门时，只见一男一女带着一帮手下站在门外。
“田萧，你别欺人太甚！不要仗着你是田长老之孙就可以在外门肆无忌惮。”李天大声说道。
“废物李天，还敢顶嘴？”其中那个女的嗲声嗲气地说。
“哎哟，李天，几天不见，胆子长肥了。既然敢顶嘴了，你这个废物，上去给他点颜色看看。”田萧对手下小弟说。
他们冲上去就是一顿拳打脚踢，再次把李天打得浑身是血。面对都是练体境四重天的一帮人，还有一个炼体九重天的田萧虎视眈眈，李天哪里是对手。
田萧再次大骂：“废物！”然后带着自己手下离去。
看着他们离去的背影，听到“废物”这两个字在李天心里犹如毒物般嘶心裂肺。他恶狠狠地看着这一帮人，心里想着，早晚让他们百倍奉还。
曾几何时，自己的天赋远超于众人，外门榜首，可晋升成为内门弟子，得到宗门的重点培养。可是自从那一天起，自己的命运彻底改变了。
赵思，自己的未婚妻。李天怎么也想不到，她和田萧合谋骗自己去青阳山脉，要自己猎杀血魔兽帮她提升实力。叫来了田萧的大哥田武，趁自己灵力耗尽，偷袭自己，废掉了自己的丹田，夺走了自己的血脉。田萧从炼体四重天一举冲到炼体境九重天，成为榜首，得到宗门重点培养。
当时的李天本以为就此结束一生。奈何天不绝自己，昏迷几天后的李天从外面拖着严重的伤势回来，重新进入外门。自此以后，天天受尽欺辱。十年来看自己伤势好点就给自己揍一顿。
外院四长老王维知道了此事，上报刑法堂。但大长老在宗门一手遮天，此件事情最终以证据不足草草了事。还以自己诬陷同门为由，把自己逐出外院，赶了出来，丢进杂员堂。
四长老王维为了他更是下跪祈求内院五长老来帮他医治。李天想起过去的种种欺辱，暗暗发誓一定要将他们百倍偿还。
李天握紧拳头向屋内走去。这时外院四长老听说自己被打急忙跑了出来关切地看望李天。看着又是一身伤的李天四长老心疼不已但奈何自己人微言轻人家有后台要是自己实力强一些就好了四长老嘴里说着。
看着这一头花白的老人李天心里不是滋味从小把自己收养的四长老已经做的够多了。
四长老把自己身上刚购买的二阶淬体丹递给了李天后便出门了暗暗下定决心如果这里实在待不下去就辞去外门长老之位带着李天隐居深山再也不出来了凭自己天神境初阶的实力怎么也会让李天过得很好。

Tianwu Continent has four major martial realms: Tianwu Realm, Qiankun Martial Realm, Cangshan Martial Realm, and Martial God Realm. Each military domain is composed of a royal family and a sect, and there are many sects. Among them, the strongest of the four martial realms is the Martial God Realm, while the weakest martial realm is the Tianwu Realm. Yuanshen Sect is located in this weakest martial domain.
"Li Tian, ​​you loser, get out of here!" The yelling and yelling outside the room made Li Tian get up immediately on the bed. He was covered in injuries and walked with a limp. When Li Tian opened the door, he saw a man and a woman standing outside the door with a group of men.
"Tian Xiao, don't bully others too much! Don't just rely on the fact that you are the grandson of Elder Tian to be unscrupulous in the outer sect." Li Tian said loudly.
"You trash Li Tian, ​​how dare you talk back?" the woman among them said in a cooing voice.
"Oh, Li Tian, ​​I haven't seen you for a few days, and I have gained courage. Since you dare to talk back, you loser, go up and give him some color." Tian Xiao said to his younger brother.
They rushed up and kicked and punched Li Tian again until he was covered in blood. Facing a group of people who are all in the fourth level of physical training, and there is also Tian Xiao, who is in the ninth level of physical training, eyeing them, Li Tian is no match.
Tian Xiao yelled again: "Trash!" and then left with his men.
Watching their leaving figures, hearing the word "trash" was like poison in Li Tian's heart. He looked at this group of people fiercely, thinking that sooner or later, they would pay them back a hundredfold.
Once upon a time, my talent far surpassed that of others, and I was ranked first in the outer sect. I could be promoted to become a disciple of the inner sect, and received key training from the sect. But since that day, his destiny has completely changed.
Zhao Si, his fiancée. Li Tian never imagined that she and Tian Xiao conspired to trick him into going to the Qingyang Mountains so that he could hunt the blood monsters and help her improve her strength. Tian Xiao's eldest brother Tian Wu was called, and while his spiritual power was exhausted, he attacked him secretly, destroyed his Dantian, and took away his blood. Tian Xiao rushed from the fourth level of body refining to the ninth level of body refining in one fell swoop, becoming the top one and receiving key training from the sect.
At that time, Li Tian originally thought that his life would end here. But Tianbu couldn't stop himself. Li Tian, ​​who had been unconscious for several days, came back from outside with serious injuries and re-entered the outer door. From then on, he was bullied every day. For ten years, I would give myself a beating when my injuries improved.
Wang Wei, the fourth elder of the outer court, found out about the matter and reported it to the Criminal Law Hall. However, the great elder controlled everything in the sect, and the matter was finally settled hastily due to lack of evidence. He also expelled himself from the outer courtyard on the grounds that he had framed his fellow disciples, kicked him out, and threw him into the Miscellaneous Hall.
Wang Wei, the fourth elder, knelt down and begged the fifth elder of the inner courtyard to help him heal him. Li Tian thought of all the insults in the past and secretly vowed to repay them a hundred times.
Li Tian clenched his fists and walked into the house. At this time, the fourth elder of the outer courtyard heard that he had been beaten and hurried out to visit Li Tian with concern. Seeing the fourth elder Li Tian who was injured again, he was heartbroken. However, he was a young man and said that it would be better if he was stronger. The fourth elder said in his mouth.
Looking at this gray-haired old man, Li Tian felt bad. The fourth elder who had adopted him since childhood had already done enough.
The fourth elder handed the second-level body tempering pill he had just purchased to Li Tianhou and went out, secretly deciding that if he couldn't stay here any longer, he would resign as an outer elder and take Li Tian to live in seclusion in the mountains and never come out again. With his strength at the elementary level of the God Realm, Li Tian would be able to live a good life.
